title: Show HN: Building a web server in assembly to give my life (a lack of) meaning
summary: A static file web server for macOS written entirely in ARM64 assembly language, implementing standard HTTP methods (GET, PUT, DELETE, HEAD, OPTIONS), Range requests for video streaming, URL decoding, and security features like docroot enforcement and slowloris mitigation.
problem_solved: Provides an extreme low-level learning exercise by implementing a complete, functional web server without any high-level languages or libraries.
why_valuable: Demonstrates deep understanding of computer systems, memory management, network protocols, and CPU architecture through the challenging medium of pure assembly programming.
